info.title: BSD FOOTBALL API
info.description: Free REST API for football data and ML predictions. Access leagues, teams, events, live scores, odds, player stats, and CatBoost-powered match predictions across 30+ leagues.

get.description: All active bookmakers as {slug, name}. No detail endpoint, no pagination, no filters — there are ~15 of them. The `consensus` entry is a synthetic average across the rest, not a real bookmaker.

get.description: Aggregated head-to-head stats for the two teams in this event. Returns null for all fields if no history is indexed.

Unified lineups endpoint covering three states via the `lineup_status` discriminator:

- `confirmed` — official XI published by the club. Available ~1 hour before kickoff and persists after the match. `confidence` and `ai_score` are always `null` in this state.
- `predicted` — AI-generated lineup with `confidence` and per-player `ai_score` (both 0–1, four decimals). Only served for matches that have not started. The `beta: true` flag is set only in this state.
- `unavailable` — no lineup data yet; `lineups`, `unavailable_players` and `updated_at` are all null. The response is still 200, not 404.

Selection priority: confirmed > predicted > unavailable. Live and finished matches never receive predicted, even if predictions exist in the database.

Replaces the v1 endpoint `/api/predicted-lineup/{id}/`.
Jerseys, pre-match facts, AI-generated preview text.
Consensus decimal odds. Markets: 1X2, Over/Under {1.5,2.5,3.5}, BTTS.

All bookmakers side-by-side for a single event. Outcome keys are codes (HOME/DRAW/AWAY/over/under/...), not team names — stable parsing even when teams are renamed. Bookmaker keys are slugs. Cached 3 min. Event with no odds returns {markets: {}}; missing event returns 404.
get.summary: Side-by-side bookmaker comparison for an event (v2)

get.description: Per-player statistics for every player who appeared in this match (typically 22+ records). Tagged under v2 / Players because the records belong to the players domain.
Polymarket prediction-market prices for one event. Prices are implied probabilities (0–1); decimal odds = 1/price. Distinct shape from traditional odds. Cached 1 min.

Returns the CatBoost ML prediction associated with this event. The response shape matches /api/v2/predictions/{id}/. Tagged under v2 / Events because the resource hangs off the events namespace, consistent with /events/{id}/stats/ etc.
Paginated tweets and video highlights linked to this event. No temporal filters — the event already bounds the window. Cached 15 min.
Per-team merged stats (live + provider-only counters), shotmap, momentum, average positions, per-minute xG.

Lightweight list of events in their live window (event_date − 5 min to ~10 min after final whistle). Designed for high-frequency polling by livetracker dashboards. Cached in Redis with TTL 30 s. For full event detail use /api/v2/events/{id}/.

Paginated list of latest odds across bookmakers. Each item is one (event, bookmaker, market, outcome) tuple at its most recent observation. Standard v2 wrapper (count + next + previous + results). Cached 3 min.

When no event_id/league_id/season_id/team_id or updated_after filter is given, results default to the last 48h of observations (the meaningful "latest odds" window). Pass an explicit updated_after to widen it.

Market+outcome compatibility (incoherent combos return 400):
- 1x2            → HOME, DRAW, AWAY
- btts           → yes, no
- over_under_15/25/35 → over, under
- double_chance  → 1X, 12, X2
- draw_no_bet    → HOME, AWAY
- total_corners  → over, under (line in `line` field)
- corners_1x2    → HOME, DRAW, AWAY (which team has more corners)
- total_red_cards → over, under (line in `line` field)
- red_card       → yes, no (a red card is shown in the match)

For total_corners/total_red_cards the handicap line varies per quote and is returned in the `line` field (null for all other markets).

For event-scoped side-by-side comparison use `/api/v2/events/{id}/odds/comparison/`.

handle.description: Social media handle (e.g. Twitter username without @). Empty string when not available.

name.description: Display name of the account. Empty string when not available.

verified.description: True if the account holds a platform-verified badge.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the prediction was generated (ISO 8601, Z suffix).

event.description: Brief summary of the match this prediction covers.

markets.description: Market-grouped probabilities (match result, xG, over/under, BTTS, score).

recommendations.description: Betting recommendations derived from the model probabilities and market edge.

model.description: Model metadata: confidence score and version.

name.description: Official name of the stadium or arena.

city.description: City where the venue is located. Empty string when not set.

country.description: Country name. Empty string when not set.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. PT, ES). Empty string when not set.

capacity.description: Seating capacity of the venue. Null when not recorded.

latitude.description: WGS-84 latitude (decimal degrees). Null when not georeferenced.

longitude.description: WGS-84 longitude (decimal degrees). Null when not georeferenced.

pitch_length_m.description: Pitch length in metres. Null when not recorded.

pitch_width_m.description: Pitch width in metres. Null when not recorded.

built_year.description: Year the venue was built or officially opened. Null when not recorded.

home_team_id.description: Internal ID of the team that uses this venue as their home ground. Null for neutral or unassigned venues.

confidence.description: Overall model confidence for this prediction (0–1). Higher values indicate higher certainty.

version.description: Version identifier of the ML model that generated this prediction (e.g. "v4").

kind.description: Clip type: full (full match), goals (all goals), key (key moments), or clip (short highlight).

title.description: Display title of the video clip.

url.description: YouTube URL of the highlight video.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail image URL. Null when not available.

published_at.description: UTC datetime when the clip was published.

lineup_status.description:
`confirmed` — official XI published by the club (≈1h before kickoff). `predicted` — AI-generated, only served for matches that have not started. `unavailable` — no lineup data; `lineups`, `unavailable_players` and `updated_at` are all null.

* `unavailable` - unavailable
* `predicted` - predicted
* `confirmed` - confirmed

beta.description: Always present. `true` only when `lineup_status` is `predicted` — confirmed lineups are not beta.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC ending in `Z`. Null when `lineup_status` is `unavailable`.

event_id.description: Internal ID of the match this quote belongs to.

market.description:
Betting market (e.g. 1x2, btts, over_under_25).

* `1x2` - 1x2
* `btts` - btts
* `over_under_15` - over_under_15
* `over_under_25` - over_under_25
* `over_under_35` - over_under_35
* `double_chance` - double_chance
* `draw_no_bet` - draw_no_bet
* `total_corners` - total_corners
* `corners_1x2` - corners_1x2
* `total_red_cards` - total_red_cards
* `red_card` - red_card

outcome.description:
Selection within the market (e.g. HOME, DRAW, AWAY, over, under, yes, no).

* `HOME` - HOME
* `DRAW` - DRAW
* `AWAY` - AWAY
* `over` - over
* `under` - under
* `yes` - yes
* `no` - no
* `1X` - 1X
* `12` - 12
* `X2` - X2

line.description: Handicap or totals line. Only set for total_corners and total_red_cards markets; null for all others.

outcome_name.description: Human-readable label for the outcome (e.g. "Over 2.5"). Null when not available.

decimal_odds.description: Current decimal odds (e.g. 1.85). Multiply by stake to get total return.

previous_decimal_odds.description: Previous odds observation before the last change. Null on first observation.

implied_probability.description: Implied win probability derived from decimal_odds (1 / decimal_odds), ignoring the overround.

movement.description:
Direction of the most recent odds move: SHORTENING (odds fell = more likely) or DRIFTING (odds rose = less likely). Empty string if unchanged.

* `SHORTENING` - SHORTENING
* `DRIFTING` - DRIFTING

is_max_quote.description: True when this is the best available price across all tracked bookmakers for this market + outcome.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last odds change (ISO 8601, Z suffix).

event_date.description: ISO-8601 UTC with literal Z suffix (e.g. 2026-05-06T04:00:00Z).

last_updated.description: Per-event Event.updated_at as ISO-8601 UTC (Z suffix). Useful for clients to skip polls when the row has not changed.

name.description: Full official name of the league or competition (e.g. "Premier League").

country.description: Country the league belongs to (e.g. "England"). Empty string for international competitions.

is_active.description: True if the league is currently active and receiving data updates.

current_season.description: The season currently flagged as active. Null if none is marked current (e.g. between cycles).

reason.description: Free-text reason — e.g. `Muscle Injury`, `5 yellow cards`.

player_id.description: Internal Player id if the call-up resolved to an existing player record. null when the player is not yet in our Player table — name + club + caps + age remain populated from the source announcement.

event_id.description: Internal ID of the match being broadcast.

home_team_id.description: Internal ID of the home team. Null when not resolved.

away_team_id.description: Internal ID of the away team. Null when not resolved.

league_id.description: Internal ID of the competition. Null when not assigned.

league_name.description: Competition name. Null when not assigned.

event_date.description: Scheduled kick-off time in UTC (ISO 8601, Z suffix).

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the target broadcast territory.

channel_id.description: Internal ID of the broadcasting TV channel.

channel_name.description: Display name of the broadcasting channel.

channel_link.description: URL to the channel's website or stream page. Empty string when not set.

scheduled_start_time.description: UTC time the broadcast is scheduled to start (ISO 8601, Z suffix). Falls back to kick-off time when no specific start time is recorded.

name.description: Full display name of the player.

short_name.description: Abbreviated name (e.g. "V. Gyökeres"). Empty string when not set.

position.description: Generic position code: G (Goalkeeper), D (Defender), M (Midfielder), F (Forward). Empty string when unknown.

specific_position.description: Specific position label (e.g. "Centre Back", "Attacking Midfielder"). Empty string when not set.

jersey_number.description: Shirt number at the current club. Null when not available.

date_of_birth.description: Player date of birth (ISO 8601). Null when not available.

height_cm.description: Height in centimetres. Null when not available.

weight_kg.description: Weight in kilograms. Null when not available.

preferred_foot.description: Preferred foot: "left", "right", or "both". Empty string when unknown.

nationality.description: Player nationality (country name in English). Empty string when unknown.

current_team_id.description: ID of the player's current club. Use /api/v2/teams/{id}/ for details. Null when unattached.

national_team_id.description: ID of the player's national team. Null when not capped.

market_value_eur.description: Estimated market value in EUR (Transfermarkt-sourced). Null when not available.

contract_until.description: Contract expiry date (ISO 8601). Null when unknown or out of contract.

attributes.description: FM-sourced scouting attribute scores (0–20 per category). Null when no scouting data exists.

strengths.description: List of identified strength labels (e.g. ["Aerial Threat", "Dribbling"]). Empty list when not available.

weaknesses.description: List of identified weakness labels. Empty list when not available.

rating.description: Overall FM scouting ability rating (0–200). Higher is better. Null when not available.

potential.description: FM potential label (e.g. "Can Still Improve", "Reached Potential"). Null when not available.

injury_risk.description: FM injury proneness label (e.g. "Unlikely", "Sometimes", "Often"). Null when not available.

wage_eur_annual.description: Estimated annual gross wage in EUR. Null when not available.

league_id.description: League this match belongs to. Use /api/v2/leagues/{id}/ for details. Null if unassigned.

season_id.description: Season this match belongs to. Null if not assigned to a season.

home_team_id.description: Internal ID of the home team. Use /api/v2/teams/{id}/ for details.

home_team.description: Home team name (string, for display convenience).

away_team_id.description: Internal ID of the away team. Use /api/v2/teams/{id}/ for details.

away_team.description: Away team name (string, for display convenience).

home_coach_id.description: Internal ID of the home team's head coach. Use /api/v2/managers/{id}/. Null when not available.

away_coach_id.description: Internal ID of the away team's head coach. Null when not available.

referee_id.description: Internal ID of the referee. Use /api/v2/referees/{id}/. Null when not available.

venue_id.description: Internal ID of the stadium. Use /api/v2/venues/{id}/. Falls back to the home team's default stadium. Null when unknown.

status.description: Match lifecycle status. Common values: notstarted, inprogress, 1st_half, halftime, 2nd_half, finished, aet (after extra time), postponed, cancelled.

replaced_by.description: If this match was postponed and later replayed, this is the ID of the replacement event. Null otherwise.

round_number.description: Numeric match week or round (e.g. 28 for gameweek 28). Null for cup knockout rounds.

round_name.description: Round label (e.g. "Round of 16", "Gameweek 28"). Empty string when not set.

group_name.description: Group stage name (e.g. "Group A"). Null for knockout or league formats.

period.description: Current period for live matches (e.g. "1st_half", "2nd_half", "extra_time"). Empty string when not live.

current_minute.description: Elapsed minutes in the current period for live matches. Null when not live.

home_score.description: Home team goals at full time (excludes penalty shootout). Null before match starts.

away_score.description: Away team goals at full time (excludes penalty shootout). Null before match starts.

home_score_ht.description: Home team goals at half time. Null before half time.

away_score_ht.description: Away team goals at half time. Null before half time.

penalty_shootout.description: Penalty shootout score (home/away). Non-null only when the match was decided by a shootout.

extra_time_score.description: Goals scored in extra time only (home/away). Non-null when status is aet or penalties.

is_local_derby.description: True when both teams are from the same city or metropolitan area.

is_neutral_ground.description: True when the match is played at a neutral venue (e.g. cup finals, World Cup).

travel_distance_km.description: Straight-line distance in km between the two teams' home cities. Null when geodata is missing.

weather.description: Weather conditions at kick-off. All sub-fields may be null when data is unavailable.

pitch_condition.description: Pitch condition code from the data provider. Null when not reported.

attendance.description: Official match attendance figure. Null when not reported.

live_websocket.description: True when this match can be subscribed to via /ws/live/ for real-time score, clock, and ball-movement updates.

highlights.description: Post-match highlight videos linked to this event. Empty list for upcoming or live matches.

head_to_head.description: Head-to-head aggregate between the two teams: total_matches, home_wins, draws, away_wins, home_goals, away_goals, avg_total_goals, home_win_rate, away_win_rate, recent_matches. Null when no H2H history is found.

type.description:
Media asset type: image or video.

* `image` - image
* `video` - video

url.description: Direct URL to the media asset.

width.description: Width in pixels. Null when not recorded.

height.description: Height in pixels. Null when not recorded.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds. Only present for video type; null when not recorded.

prob_home.description: Model probability (0–1) of a home win.

prob_away.description: Model probability (0–1) of an away win.

predicted.description:
Most likely outcome: H (home win), D (draw), or A (away win). Null when probabilities are too close to call.

* `H` - H
* `D` - D
* `A` - A

event_date.description: Scheduled kick-off time in UTC (ISO 8601, Z suffix).

home_team_id.description: Internal ID of the home team.

away_team_id.description: Internal ID of the away team.

league_id.description: Internal ID of the competition. Null if unassigned.

description.description: Human-readable weather label derived from the code (e.g. "clear", "rain").

wind_speed.description: Wind speed in km/h at match time. Null when not available.

temperature_c.description: Air temperature in Celsius at match time. Null when not available.

ai_score.description: AI confidence score 0–1, four decimals. Always null when `lineup_status` is `confirmed`.

name.description: Full display name of the referee.

country.description: Country name. Empty string when not set.

nationality_a3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 nationality code (e.g. PRT, ESP). Empty string when not set.

birthdate.description: Date of birth (ISO 8601). Null when not recorded.

matches.description: Number of finished matches officiated in the filtered scope (or all-time when no filter applied).

total_yellow_cards.description: Total yellow cards shown across all counted matches.

total_red_cards.description: Total red cards shown (includes straight reds and second yellows).

avg_yellow_per_match.description: Average yellow cards per match. Null when no matches played.

avg_red_per_match.description: Average red cards per match. Null when no matches played.

avg_goals_per_match.description: Average total goals per match. Null when no matches played.

avg_fouls_per_match.description: Average total fouls per match (home + away). Null when foul data is unavailable.

career_games.description: Total career matches officiated (lifetime, from external source). Null when not recorded.

career_yellow_cards.description: Total career yellow cards issued. Null when not recorded.

career_red_cards.description: Total career red cards issued. Null when not recorded.

prob_over_15.description: Probability (0–1) that the match has more than 1.5 total goals.

prob_over_25.description: Probability (0–1) that the match has more than 2.5 total goals.

prob_over_35.description: Probability (0–1) that the match has more than 3.5 total goals.

home.description: Penalties scored by the home team.

away.description: Penalties scored by the away team.

name.description: Full display name of the manager.

short_name.description: Abbreviated name used in compact views. Empty string when not set.

country.description: Country of nationality. Empty string when not set.

tactical_profile.description: Broad tactical label: attacking, defensive, or balanced. Empty string when not profiled.

preferred_formation.description: Most commonly deployed formation (e.g. "4-3-3"). Empty string when not recorded.

current_team_id.description: Internal ID of the club where the manager currently has an active tenure. Null if unemployed or unknown.

matches_total.description: Total matches managed across all counted tenures.

wins.description: Total wins across all counted matches.

draws.description: Total draws across all counted matches.

losses.description: Total losses across all counted matches.

win_pct.description: Win percentage (0–100). Null when no matches managed.

avg_goals_scored.description: Average goals scored per match by the manager's team. Null when no data.

avg_goals_conceded.description: Average goals conceded per match. Null when no data.

avg_possession.description: Average ball possession percentage across tracked matches. Null when possession data unavailable.

clean_sheet_pct.description: Percentage of matches where the managed team kept a clean sheet. Null when no data.

btts_pct.description: Percentage of matches where both teams scored (BTTS). Null when no data.

over_25_pct.description: Percentage of matches with more than 2.5 total goals. Null when no data.

stats_updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when aggregated stats were last recomputed. Null if never computed.

short_name.description: Abbreviated name (e.g. "Man City"). Empty string when not set.

country.description: Country the team represents (e.g. "England"). Empty string when unknown.

venue_id.description: ID of the team's home stadium. Use /api/v2/venues/{id}/ for details. Null when no venue is linked.

event_date.description: Scheduled kick-off time in UTC (ISO 8601, Z suffix).

teams.description: Teams linked to this social item.

events.description: Matches linked to this social item.

players.description: Players linked to this social item (id + name).

managers.description: Managers linked to this social item (id + name).

type.description:
Content type: tweet (Twitter/X post) or video (highlight clip).

* `tweet` - tweet
* `video` - video

url.description: Canonical URL of the original post or video.

text.description: Body text of the tweet or video caption. Empty string when not available.

title.description: Title for video items. Empty string for tweets or when not set.

thumbnail.description: URL of the best available thumbnail image. Empty string when no media is attached.

media.description: Normalized media attachments (images and videos). Empty array when there are none.

account.description: The social account that published this item.

published_at.description: UTC timestamp when the item was published (ISO 8601, Z suffix).

linked.description: BSD entities associated with this social item.

slug.description: Machine-readable bookmaker identifier (e.g. "bet365"). Use this as the bookmaker_slug filter.

match_result.description: 1X2 match result probabilities and predicted outcome.

over_under.description: Over/under goal probabilities for the 1.5, 2.5, and 3.5 lines.

btts.description: Both Teams To Score (BTTS) market probability.

most_likely.description: Most likely final scoreline (e.g. "2-1"). Null when not computed.

home.description: Expected goals (xG) for the home team. Null when not computed.

away.description: Expected goals (xG) for the away team. Null when not computed.

favorite.description:
Model-identified favourite: H (home) or A (away). Null when no clear favourite.

* `H` - H
* `A` - A

favorite_prob.description: Win probability (0–1) of the favourite. Null when no favourite.

bet_favorite.description: True when the model recommends betting on the favourite (based on edge vs. market odds).

over_15.description: True when the model recommends the Over 1.5 goals bet.

over_25.description: True when the model recommends the Over 2.5 goals bet.

over_35.description: True when the model recommends the Over 3.5 goals bet.

btts.description: True when the model recommends the Both Teams To Score (Yes) bet.

winner.description: True when the model recommends betting on the predicted winner.

attacking.description: Attacking attribute score (0–20 FM scale). Null when not available.

position.description: Primary position from the scouting model (e.g. "Striker", "Centre Back").

confidence.description: AI confidence for the predicted formation, 0–1, four decimals. Always null when `lineup_status` is `confirmed`.

home.description: Goals scored by the home team in extra time only.

away.description: Goals scored by the away team in extra time only.

year.description: Season start year (e.g. 2025). Null for competitions without a standard year.

start_date.description: Date the season starts (ISO 8601). Null when not set.

end_date.description: Date the season ends (ISO 8601). Null when not set.

is_current.description: True if this is the active season for the league.

name.description: Display name of the channel (e.g. "BT Sport 1").

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the channel's primary broadcast region.

link.description: URL to the channel's website or stream page. Empty string when not set.

prob_yes.description: Probability (0–1) that both teams score at least one goal (BTTS).
